Class StaticLineMap

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticLineMap
@Internal public final class StaticLineMap extends Object
The Python positions of the Java a stub with compiled bodies is compiled to, so that a stack trace or a debugger shows the Python file and line of a compiled statement rather than the generated Java.

A stack trace element and the default stratum of a debugger take the file from the SourceFile attribute of the class and the line from the LineNumberTable of the method: a JSR-45 SourceDebugExtension is read by debuggers only. So the class files compiled from such a stub are rewritten: SourceFile names the Python file and each line of a compiled method is the Python line of the statement it was generated from, or the line of the def for the code the stub adds around the statements. The lines of the other methods of the stub, which bridge to Python, have no Python statement: they are dropped, and the frames of those methods show the Python file without a line.

The positions travel in the generated Java source itself: the Compiled from javadoc of a compiled method gives the file and the def line, and a // Python line N comment the line of the statements that follow it, up to the next comment at the same or a lower indentation. SourceGen writes no comments: the body generator writes a marker statement (marker(int)), which the stub generator turns into the comment once the source is written (withLineComments(String)). A compiler that writes the class files of the stubs reads the source the class was compiled from (of(CharSequence)) and rewrites each class file (apply(byte[], String)).

    • apply

      public byte[] apply(byte[] classFile, String javaSourceFile)
      Rewrites a class file compiled from the source to the Python positions. A class file whose SourceFile attribute does not name the source (one compiled without debugging information, or not compiled from it) is left as it is, and so is one that cannot be rewritten.
      Parameters:
      classFile - The class file javac wrote
      javaSourceFile - The name of the Java source file the positions were read from
      Returns:
      The rewritten class file, or the given one
